title: The query on an encoded pair
statement: Let $f$ map finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings, and let $x$ and $b$ be finite Boolean strings. Applying the query transformation to the encoding of $(x,b)$ returns the encoding of $(f(x),b)$ if $b$ is empty or its last bit is true, and returns the empty string otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings
